profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northwestern Mutual
profile.summary: Software engineer leveraging a sales background who specializes in developing innovative solutions and maintaining an exceptional user experience.  Recognized as an organized and adaptable critical thinker, I am dedicated to improve my expertise while embracing new challenges alongside an innovative team focused on coding accessible, human-centered products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.insights: Web Application Development and Web Applications

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Mentor students through the fundamentals of HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
- Working with my team to help create and structure lesson plans for Office Hours
- Assist the instructor with questions students have during the lesson plan. 
- Pushing updates to the curriculum via Gitlab.
- Assist students in the installation process of software and libraries.
positions.insights: Web Application Development and Web Applications

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineering reusable web and native React components for a cognitive behavioral therapy focused application to allow a user to challenge negative thoughts and understand cognitive distortions.
- Utilizing agile software development strategies to prototype, implement, and deploy features embedded within a cross functional and multi disciplinary team.
- Implementing industry React and React Native best practices within Expo and Next.js environments to maximize the reusability and extensibility of my code.
positions.insights: Web Application Development and Web Applications

positions.title: Licensed Real Estate Agent
positions.description:
• Proven ability to increase agency revenue by additional $1MM year-over-year, while closing contracts and acquiring clients through marketing, sales, and customer relations.
• Provide competitive analysis and industry benchmarking of NY Real Estate Market in order to properly position the firm’s strategies against competitors, while increasing earnings and gaining market share.
• Coach and train junior agents in order to aid in the development of their sales presence. Won the Producers Silver Medal in 2018 & 2019 for excellence in revenue again.
